title: Task and Flow Management
summary: This module provides the core framework for defining, orchestrating, and managing complex AI agent workflows (flows). It handles state persistence, human-in-the-loop interactions, event management, and flow visualization.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Flow Execution
nodes.title: Flow Orchestration Core
nodes.description: Manages the entire lifecycle of a flow, including initiation, state transitions, method execution, event handling, and error management. It coordinates the execution of tasks and listeners based on defined conditions.

nodes.label: Define Flow Structure
nodes.title: Flow Definition & Logic
nodes.description: Provides the metaclass and decorators for defining the structure of a flow, including start methods, listeners, routers, and their triggering conditions.

nodes.label: Persist Flow State
nodes.title: Flow State Persistence
nodes.description: Defines the abstract interface for persisting and loading flow state, enabling long-running and resumable flows. Includes decorators for automatic state persistence.

nodes.label: Manage Human Feedback
nodes.title: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)
nodes.description: Handles interactions requiring human input or feedback, including pausing flows, collecting responses, and interpreting feedback using LLMs for routing decisions.

nodes.label: Analyze & Visualize Flows
nodes.title: Flow Analysis & Viz
nodes.description: Provides tools for introspecting the structure of a flow, calculating method dependencies, and generating interactive visual diagrams.

nodes.label: Implement Specialized Tasks
nodes.title: Specialized Task Types
nodes.description: Offers advanced task types like conditional execution and placeholder guardrails for content validation within a flow.

nodes.label: Serialize & Deserialize State
nodes.title: State Serialization
nodes.description: Handles the serialization and deserialization of flow state and Pydantic models, crucial for persistence and checkpointing.

nodes.label: Event Bus
nodes.title: Event Management
nodes.description: Central system for emitting and listening to flow events, crucial for tracing, logging, and inter-component communication.

nodes.label: LLM Integrations
nodes.title: LLM Access
nodes.description: Provides interfaces to various Large Language Models for AI-driven tasks within the flow, such as feedback interpretation.

nodes.label: Flow Memory
nodes.title: Memory Management
nodes.description: Manages the flow's memory, allowing agents to recall and remember information across tasks.

nodes.label: CLI Commands
nodes.title: Command Line Interface
nodes.description: Provides command-line tools for running and plotting flows.

nodes.label: Agent & Crew Orchestration
nodes.title: Agent Management
nodes.description: Manages the execution and coordination of agents and crews within a flow.

groups.label: Flow Core Orchestration
groups.title: Flow Core
groups.description: Central components responsible for the execution, state management, and lifecycle of AI agent flows.

groups.label: Flow Definition & Logic
groups.title: Flow Definition
groups.description: Components for defining the structure, methods, and conditional logic that govern flow execution.

groups.label: State Management & Persistence
groups.title: State & Persistence
groups.description: Handles the saving, loading, and management of flow state, enabling checkpointing and resumable workflows.

groups.label: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)
groups.title: Human Interaction
groups.description: Facilitates human intervention and feedback within automated flows, allowing for guided execution and decision-making.

groups.label: Flow Analysis & Visualization

groups.label: Specialized Task Types

groups.label: State Serialization
groups.title: Serialization
